resources.string: A small translator for German. It opens from a bubble you can drag, and it snaps to the side of the screen.
The system bubble is off. The De button on this screen still translates.
The system bubble is on. It stays up while you use other apps.
Android needs permission before a bubble can draw over other apps. Until you allow it, use the De button on this screen.

Deutsch Widget adds a small bubble that stays on screen while you use other apps. Android will open a setting where you allow display over other apps. You can turn the bubble off here at any time. Translation inside this app does not need that permission.
Drag the De button. It snaps to the left or right edge. Tap to translate. Close, or tap the bubble again, to collapse it.
Drag the bubble to snap it to an edge. Tap to translate.
